entities.name: Measurement Configuration
entities.description: Network configuration of UE measurements in RRC_CONNECTED state using dedicated signaling (RRCReconfiguration or RRCResume). Includes measurement objects, reporting configurations, measurement identities, quantity configurations, and measurement gaps.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: RRC message used to provide measurement configuration to UE via dedicated signaling.

entities.name: RRCResume
entities.description: RRC message used to provide measurement configuration to UE via dedicated signaling.

entities.name: measConfig
entities.description: Measurement configuration provided to UE, containing measurement objects, reporting configurations, measurement identities, quantity configurations, and measurement gaps.

entities.name: Measurement Object
entities.description: Defines objects on which UE performs measurements, including frequency/time location, subcarrier spacing, and cell lists (allow-listed/exclude-listed).

entities.name: Reporting Configuration
entities.description: Configuration for measurement reporting including reporting criterion (periodical/event), RS type, and reporting format.

entities.name: Measurement Identity
entities.description: Links measurement objects with reporting configurations, included in measurement reports as reference.

entities.name: Quantity Configuration
entities.description: Defines measurement filtering configuration for event evaluation and periodical reporting.

entities.name: Measurement Gap
entities.description: Periods that UE may use to perform measurements.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE maintains measurement configuration and performs measurements.

entities.name: Same RAT Type Linking
entities.description: Measurement objects can only be linked to reporting configurations of the same RAT type.

entities.name: Maintain Measurement Lists
entities.description: UE in RRC_CONNECTED maintains measurement object list, reporting configuration list, and measurement identities list.

relations.description: Measurement configuration procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Measurement identity links measurement object to reporting configuration.
Measurement identity links reporting configuration to measurement object.
Measurement objects can only be linked to reporting configurations of same RAT type.
UE maintains measurement lists when in RRC_CONNECTED state.
